User: Portion size. It's all about portion size when it comes to fast food. I want to be able to get a quality amount of food because I know that your restaurant produces quality food. Besides quantity, if I get rewards for purchasing at the restaurant, I consider that value.
Agent: That's very clear. Now, compared to your last fast-food order, what changed today, if anything? Please pick the biggest driver and explain it, whether it was your mood, cravings, schedule, budget, health goals, social plans, or convenience.
